author: p. r. head
title: Judd Utermark named to 2026 NCBWA All-America Third Team
text:
Ole Miss senior Judd Utermark was named to the National Collegiate Baseball Writers Association (NCBWA) 2026 College Baseball All-America Third Team, the organization announced on June 10. Utermark is the first Rebel position player to earn All-America honors since Kemp Alderman in 2023.
Utermark leads Ole Miss in several offensive categories, including batting average, slugging percentage, on-base percentage, runs scored, hits, and total bases. Heading into Omaha, he holds a .312 batting average with 22 home runs, 53 runs batted in (RBI), 72 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases.
His total of 72 runs scored ranks fifth-most in the Southeastern Conference (SEC), while his average of 1.16 runs per game is seventh-highest among conference players. This season, Utermark became Ole Miss’s all-time home run leader with a career total of 51 home runs. He is also the first player in program history to achieve back-to-back seasons with more than twenty home runs.
The recognition by the NCBWA highlights Utermark’s significant contributions during his collegiate career at Ole Miss.
